parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end date in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. Only day-level queries are supported. Refer to the examples for parameter settings.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: SkillGroupIds
parameters.description: The list of skill group IDs, separated by commas (,). A maximum of 50 IDs can be specified. If this parameter is not specified, all skill groups are queried.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start date in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. Only day-level queries are supported. Refer to the examples for parameter settings. The start date cannot be earlier than 31 days before the current date.
